tasks.title: Publish recovery verb spec deltas for API, CLI, and Web UI
tasks.description: Create the change-local spec deltas for `reopen-resume`, `http-api`, `cli-interface`, and `web-ui` so this change has explicit SHALL requirements before code implementation. The deltas should capture that `reopen` is closed-only, `resume` handles paused/interrupted recovery, `restart` is removed or deprecated, and blocked user-facing labels become failure-oriented guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: The change directory contains spec delta files for reopen-resume, http-api, cli-interface, and web-ui
The spec deltas define reopen as closed-only and resume as the recovery action for paused/interrupted issues
The spec deltas define restart as unavailable or deprecated with guidance to retry/rerun/rewind
The spec deltas define Web/CLI user-facing labels and actions consistent with the proposal and design
tasks.notes: This change currently has no spec delta files; publish them first so implementation tasks have stable acceptance anchors.

tasks.title: Implement backend recovery semantics and split reopen from resume
tasks.description: Add a shared recovery-semantics decision path in the backend and use it to enforce distinct meanings for `reopen`, `resume`, `retry`, `rerun`, and deprecated `restart`. This task should narrow `IssueService.reopen()` to closed issues, add `POST /api/issues/:number/resume` for paused/interrupted recovery, update retry/rerun gating to stop depending directly on `status === blocked`, and convert `/restart` into a clear migration error instead of a working reset path.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/issues/:number/reopen succeeds only for closed issues and no longer auto-enqueues resume-pipeline for blocked, paused, or interrupted issues
POST /api/issues/:number/resume resumes paused or interrupted issues without changing stage or clearing checkpoints
POST /api/issues/:number/retry no longer resets issues to backlog when no checkpoint exists and no longer requires a raw status===blocked check as its sole eligibility rule
POST /api/issues/:number/restart returns a clear deprecation error instructing callers to use retry, rerun, or rewind instead
Backend error messages no longer recommend restart in blocked or failed recovery paths
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Implement the shared recovery classification in the service/domain layer even if the first consumer is the issues API. Avoid introducing implicit reset-to-backlog fallback.

tasks.title: Align CLI recovery commands and guidance with the new verb model
tasks.description: Update CLI issue commands and output so `reopen` means reopening closed issues only, while `resume` is the explicit action for paused or interrupted work. Remove any restart-oriented help or error guidance and make blocked/failed paths point to `retry`, `rerun`, or future `rewind` commands instead.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo issue reopen <number>` only targets closed issues and no longer acts as a generic resume path
`mo issue resume <number>` calls the dedicated resume API and is described as resuming paused or interrupted work
CLI help and command output do not mention Restart as an issue recovery action
Blocked or failed CLI guidance points to retry, rerun, or rewind rather than restart
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task consumes the new backend routes and messages from T-002, so it must not guess old reopen behavior.

tasks.title: Update Web issue status surfaces to show intent-based recovery actions
tasks.description: Refactor Web issue cards, detail panels, status helpers, and API client calls so user-facing recovery actions match the new verb model. Closed issues should show Reopen, paused/interrupted issues should show Resume, failed or needs-action issues should show Retry and Rerun Stage, and Blocked should be replaced with failure-oriented labels such as Needs action or Failed while keeping diagnostic evidence visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Web UI does not show any Restart action for issue recovery
Closed issues show Reopen and do not reuse the interrupted resume flow
Paused and interrupted issues show Resume using the dedicated resume API
Blocked user-facing labels are replaced by Needs action or Failed while blockedReason remains visible as diagnostic evidence
Failed or needs-action issue surfaces offer Retry and Rerun Stage actions consistent with backend eligibility
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer consuming shared API semantics over re-encoding blocked/interrupted decisions independently in the UI.

tasks.title: Add backend regression coverage for recovery routing and restart deprecation
tasks.description: Add or update backend tests that lock in the new recovery model across service and API boundaries. The regression suite should prove reopen is closed-only, resume handles paused/interrupted, retry no longer falls back to backlog reset, and restart returns migration guidance instead of performing work.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover IssueService.reopen() rejecting blocked, paused, and interrupted issues
Tests cover POST /api/issues/:number/resume succeeding for paused or interrupted issues and preserving stage
Tests cover POST /api/issues/:number/reopen only reopening closed issues
Tests cover POST /api/issues/:number/restart returning a deprecation error without mutating stage or status
Tests cover retry rejecting no-checkpoint recovery instead of resetting to backlog
Relevant backend tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Mirror the contract in tests so future rewind work can build on a stable verb boundary.

tasks.title: Verify CLI and Web recovery behavior end to end
tasks.description: Add focused UI and CLI-facing regression coverage and run the final verification commands for this change. This task should prove the visible labels, buttons, and command guidance are consistent with the backend recovery model and that Restart has disappeared from user-facing recovery flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend or integration tests cover closed -> Reopen, paused/interrupted -> Resume, and failed/needs-action -> Retry/Rerun visibility
CLI-facing tests or snapshots cover resume vs reopen guidance and absence of restart wording
No user-facing recovery surface still renders the label Restart
npm test passes
npm run build passes
tasks.output: Verified CLI/Web recovery behavior and passing repository checks
tasks.notes: Final validation task tying together backend semantics, CLI wording, and Web presentation.
